title: Charlie Munger's #1 Mental Trick: Invert, Always Invert
alt_title_1: Why Avoiding Stupidity Beats Trying to Be Brilliant
alt_title_2: The 180-Year-Old Math Rule Charlie Munger Used for Every Decision
description_hook: Instead of asking how to get rich or productive, billionaire thinker Charlie Munger flipped every hard problem backwards using mathematician Carl Jacobi's Inversion Principle. This video covers the 5-Trap Inversion filter.

affiliate_cta.offer_name: 'Poor Charlie's Almanack' on Amazon & Audible + Inversion Filter Sheet
affiliate_cta.pinned_comment: If you inverted your #1 goal for this year, what is the single biggest daily habit trying to sabotage it? 👇 Explore 'Poor Charlie's Almanack' + grab our free 5-Trap Inversion Worksheet here: https://kenvh0010-lang.github.io/admin/bio/

scenes.headline: Stop Chasing Genius, Subtract Stupidity
bullets: Most people fail trying to pull off brilliant shortcuts
Consistent winners simply remove obvious self-sabotage
scenes.narration: Charlie Munger kept repeating one counterintuitive idea: stop straining to be brilliant, and work hard at not being stupid.

scenes.headline: Carl Jacobi's 19th-Century Math Secret
bullets: German mathematician Carl Jacobi solved impossible proofs backwards
Define the exact opposite of what you want, then avoid it
scenes.narration: Munger borrowed this mental model from nineteenth-century mathematician Carl Jacobi, who solved complex equations with three famous words: invert, always invert. Turn every hard problem upside down.
scenes.source: Charlie Munger, Poor Charlie's Almanack (2005), citing Carl Jacobi

scenes.headline: Forward Guessing vs Backwards Clarity
scenes.left_body: 'How do I build wealth fast?' -> noisy, vague, high risk
scenes.right_body: 'What guarantees staying broke?' -> debt, ego upgrades, panic
scenes.narration: Asking how to build extraordinary wealth produces vague guesses. Asking what guarantees financial ruin gives unmistakable answers: high-interest debt, status upgrades, zero skill margin, and emotional panic.

scenes.headline: Run a 5-Trap Inversion Audit Today
scenes.stat_subtext: Block top 5 failure habits -> progress becomes automatic
scenes.narration: Run a Five-Trap Inversion today: write down your top goal for the year, list the five daily behaviors guaranteed to wreck it, and build physical guardrails to eliminate them first.

scenes.headline: Zero Unforced Errors Wins Long Games
bullets: List the 5 guaranteed failure modes for health, money, and work
Remove friction from good habits and lock out the traps
scenes.narration: In compounding games, winners rarely need miracle breakthroughs, they simply commit zero unforced errors.
